title: cq-acis exact artifact, profile, and semantic-oracle boundary
mode: Primary-source release, profile, provenance, and lineage audit
scope: Refresh the already-admitted cq-acis candidate to an exact currently published artifact and source provenance.
Resolve its bounded ACIS/ASM profile matrix, particularly the BinaryFile8 limitation, before any optional comparison.
Separate parser/reference closure, shape-kernel validity, independent semantic expectations, and DWG/AcDs ownership evidence.
Audit the peer corpus policy and related Inventor tools for fixture, license, dependency, and evidence-lineage boundaries.
Refine existing PAR-07/S8 execution readiness without adding dependencies, tests, samples, or blocking implementation work.

sources.revision: PyPI release published 2026-10-16; publishing attestation names source commit e05a8f470d2f6799277f7b7df467d2fc35625889; inspected 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: The project is MIT-licensed and PyPI provides provenance linking release artifacts to the source commit. The macOS ARM64 wheel cq_acis-0.3.12-cp310-abi3-macosx_11_0_arm64.whl has SHA-256 94204f623d752e7dacf494bf631551277a985acbeb612ee3a24464ea0f0daab5. The package requires Python >=3.11 and CadQuery >=2.8.
sources.limits: Artifact availability and publisher provenance do not establish installation, host compatibility, parser correctness, or successful geometry conversion. No artifact was downloaded or installed.

sources.project: cq-acis pinned SAB/ASM profile and geometry scope
sources.revision: Source commit e05a8f470d2f6799277f7b7df467d2fc35625889, matching the PyPI attestation; inspected 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: The published profile table lists ACIS BinaryFile save version 21800 with limited native fixture coverage; selected ASM BinaryFile4 versions 22000, 22300, 22600, 22700, 22900, and 23200; and the same ASM versions for BinaryFile8 with synthetic framing coverage only and no validated native eight-byte fixture. Unknown records may remain raw; conversion supports a narrower documented geometry subset.
sources.limits: These project-authored admission claims do not apply to a payload unless its exact signature, save version, reference width, and active-record boundary match. No local DWG payload was run through cq-acis.

sources.project: acis-core API and experimental SAB authoring
sources.observed: The API states that model construction checks references/source ranges, not B-rep validity or compatibility with a particular Inventor/ASM version. It documents experimental source-free SAB box authoring for a narrow Asm23200MetricBox profile.
sources.limits: A same-project writer/reader control cannot be the sole semantic oracle and does not represent general vendor-originated ACIS history or DWG/AcDs ownership.

sources.revision: Corpus policy pinned to source commit e05a8f470d2f6799277f7b7df467d2fc35625889; release description inspected 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: The project describes a pinned corpus of 25 artifacts (23 SAT, 2 SAB) sourced from NIST engineering-design models and ezdxf, with source commits/blob hashes, file hashes, and separate license notices. The corpus is excluded from Python distribution artifacts. The NIST notice itself cautions that third-party material may be present.
sources.limits: The peer's test set measures its own regression coverage; it is not independent expected-value evidence for libdxfrw. The plan's stricter fixture rule remains in force; no corpus files were fetched or copied.

sources.observed: inventor-kit documents its pipeline through acis-core and cq-acis and identifies its current license as PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. InventorLoader is a FreeCAD workbench using FreeCAD Part and ezdxf for its DXF carrier route; it is not a DWG/AcDs reader and shares the OCCT family for shape construction.
sources.limits: These related applications do not add an independent open-source kernel or an independent DWG/AcDs association route. InventorLoader source revision and FreeCAD/ezdxf runtime were not pinned or executed in this pass.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8: pin cq-acis 0.3.12 as an optional exact-hash artifact candidate via its PyPI source attestation; no install or per-slice dependency.
PAR-07/S8: require an exact payload signature/save-format/reference-width match to cq-acis's narrow profile table before interpreting results; profile mismatch is NOT_APPLICABLE.
PAR-07/S8: distinguish reference closure, body-reachable record disposition, OCCT shape validity, independent analytic expectations, and outer DWG/AcDs owner/key association.
PAR-07/S8: treat acis-core source-free SAB authoring as experimental control generation only, and never count self-roundtrip as independent semantic evidence.
PAR-07/S8: retain the no-external-fixture policy despite peer corpus provenance; do not copy the 25-file cq-acis test corpus.
Candidate lineage inventory: inventor-kit shares acis-core/cq-acis and uses PolyForm Noncommercial licensing; InventorLoader is a FreeCAD/ezdxf route and not a DWG or independent-kernel witness.

planChanges: Added exact cq-acis 0.3.12 macOS ARM64 wheel identity and PyPI attested source commit for a reproducible optional composed-checkpoint run.
Made cq-acis ACIS BinaryFile 21800, selected ASM BinaryFile4, and synthetic-only BinaryFile8 profile limits explicit; separated them from CADMPEG 217/218 and from DWG AC code.
Clarified that acis-core reference closure and experimental source-free box authoring do not establish B-rep validity, native producer compatibility, or DWG/AcDs semantics.
Recorded cq-acis peer corpus provenance and explicitly prohibited importing/copying external corpus artifacts into this repository.

Excluded inventor-kit as an additional permissively licensed or independent route because it shares acis-core/cq-acis and is currently PolyForm Noncommercial; bounded InventorLoader to a FreeCAD/ezdxf route rather than an independent kernel or DWG parser.
Preserved fast implementation cadence, no new mandatory validation gate, no fixture/dependency changes, findings/subplan totals, and all six DEFERRED_EXTERNAL statuses.
limitations: This was primary-source documentation and release metadata research only; no package, corpus file, DWG/DXF, or native drawing was downloaded.
No cq-acis, acis-core, CadQuery, OCCT, InventorLoader, FreeCAD, CADMPEG, or libdxfrw peer comparison was executed.
The PyPI attestation binds the published artifact to a source commit but does not qualify local installation or runtime behavior.
cq-acis has bounded profiles, documented shared format references, and an OCCT-family shape conversion route; no independent-kernel or full-format claim follows.
No evidence in this pass validates DWG section parsing, AcDs/DataStorage ownership, DXF serialization, LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3, or native Linux/Windows consumer behavior.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
